contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-payment-methods-overview-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-payment-methods-overview-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-payment-methods-overview.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/overview`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 overview at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/overview explains that a merchant can turn on most methods in the Dashboard without code changes when Checkout, Payment Element, Payment Links or hosted invoices use dynamic methods. Stripe selects eligible methods for each customer. An explicit payment_method_types integration requires code changes, and method-specific prerequisites still apply (new raw lines 13-29, 42-48). The page documents ten families. Bank debits can take several business days to confirm, bank redirects require customer authentication and approval, and bank transfers are pushed to a virtual account that Stripe reconciles. Stablecoin payments settle in the Stripe balance in local currency, while closed-loop gift cards settle outside Stripe (new raw lines 31-42, 61-86, 120-126 and 157-163). The May bank-transfer paragraph said customers or businesses sent funds directly to the merchant's bank account, while the November overview explains that the merchant supplies a virtual bank account number and Stripe reconciles the customer's bank push without exposing the merchant's account details (old raw lines 64-71 and new raw lines 84-91). The Stripe Payment Methods concept's direct bank-to-bank shorthand at line 35 needs this qualification. The difference in description establishes neither a routing migration nor an external bank payout. These are family-level descriptions, not individual payment object states or account eligibility. The May 1 article (old raw lines 8-23, 39-71 and 108-118) grouped eight families and lacked the explicit activation distinction and two standalone families. source-stripe-payment-methods-overview.md summarizes May but calls those regional-use tables availability and omits the November behavior.
reviewed_answers.Q2: The November change at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/overview contains substantive activation guidance, family additions and behavior, alongside reorganized region tables and resource navigation (new raw lines 13-42, 71-126 and 137-173). Preserve the May eight-family publication including TWINT, PayNow and UPI under Bank Redirects, stablecoins under Wallets, Meses sin intereses under BNPL, Swish invite-only, and Apple Pay and Google Pay India wording (old raw lines 8-23, 49-62, 73-97 and 108-122). November gives different placements, Wero public preview alongside a separate iDEAL | Wero link, Swish private preview, US-only private-preview gift cards, and removes only the Apple Pay India label. These table changes do not establish termination or new account eligibility. Preserve the matrix distinction between regional usage and actual merchant/customer eligibility, and the scoped stablecoin business-location evidence from the separate method guide. Update source-stripe-payment-methods-overview.md with both captures and preserve root index line 7, Stripe index lines 220 and 730, and Stripe Payment Methods concept lines 88 and 92-93, adding a source backlink and keeping eligibility and integration details routed to their specific references.
